drafts.subject: Price check needed: Hovells Creek Chemicals invoice HCC/03785, PO 4500012132
drafts.body:
Hi J.,

Invoice HCC/03785 from Hovells Creek Chemicals (dated 12 September 2026, total $28,710.00 inc GST) is on hold for a price variance against PO 4500012132.

Line 1, Caustic soda 30% bulk, is billed at $1.45/L against a PO price of $1.425/L. That is 1.8% higher and $450.00 over on the line, which breaches our $250.00 per-line limit.

Could you please confirm whether the higher price was agreed with the vendor?
- If yes, please amend the PO price so we can release the invoice for payment.
- If no, let us know and AP will ask Hovells Creek Chemicals for a credit note for the $450.00 difference.

The invoice is on 30-day terms from the invoice date, so a prompt reply would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
